preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some Honey tokens to trigger swapAndLiquify
Trading must be enabled (tradingEnabled = true) and swapEnabled = true
Contract must have accumulated enough fees (balanceOf(address(this)) >= swapTokensAtAmount)

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in swapAndLiquify() function at line 578 where denominator calculation can result in precision loss. When (temp.liquidity + temp.marketing + temp.Stake + temp.Dapp) * 2 equals 0 (possible when all tax components are 0), denominator becomes 0 causing division by zero or precision issues. As owner, set all tax components to 0 using setTaxes() and setSellTaxes(), then trigger a transfer that accumulates fees in contract. When swapAndLiquify executes with denominator = 0, the calculations will fail or produce unexpected results, potentially allowing fee bypass or incorrect distribution. The attacker (as owner) can then rescue the stuck BNB using rescueBNB() function.
